overview: After playing Navarre you spoke briefly in the tiring-house with Richard Burbage and John Heminges after James walked off up Holywell Lane. All three agreed an unread five-year clause is no bargain, the timber wants pricing before any talk of pulling beams down, and your Act 3 king is still half a leaf.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Said he would not curse a man he has not seen and noted Act 3 is still half a leaf.

parties.name: Richard Burbage
parties.context: Said his father walked off up Holywell Lane and backed Cuthbert on pricing the timber first.

parties.name: John Heminges
parties.context: Called an unread clause no bargain and refused to write any figure in his book.

parties.name: James Burbage
parties.context: Already halfway up Holywell Lane before the yard was dry.

parties.name: Cuthbert Burbage
parties.context: Brought Allen's heads Saturday and wanted the timber priced first.

parties.name: Giles Allen
parties.context: Landlord refusing to let anyone read the five-year clause.
